# JobCtrl v0.4.1

JobCtrl v0.4.1 strengthens connected-browser security and repairs process cleanup, retries, optimistic edits and Remote searches. It keeps the schema-15 workspace format introduced in v0.4.0.

## Security and reliability

- Connected-browser acquisition accepts only supported provider-owned hosts and revalidates DNS before leasing a task. Other posting hosts use the worker's address-pinned public transport, closing the gap where Chrome could resolve an attacker-controlled hostname differently after validation.
- Native cleanup retains its verified completion evidence across transient process-inspection failures. Source startup and shutdown preserve ownership records so verified leftover processes can be cleaned up and the instance can restart normally.
- Pipeline retries use consistent attempt and material-reset semantics, and stale reset requests cannot erase a newer attempt or material generation.
- Failed optimistic edits preserve data written by newer requests rather than rolling it back to an older cached value.
- Remote searches can run without a location filter. Discovery rejects an unsupported preview request before dispatching work and explains how to run the supported operation.
- Dependency and test-tool updates include the pyasn1 and PDF-parser fixes already merged for this release. CI runs the primary Python version once and routes affected checks to reduce repeated work.

## Update and recovery

Run `jobctrl update` to acquire the signed release. Supported v0.4.0 installations keep their profile, resumes, settings, search configuration and Temporal history. This patch adds no database schema transition; the runtime continues to require exact schema 15.

The existing legacy-upgrade limitation remains: a normally used v0.3.1 installation lacks complete child-process ownership records, so the installer cannot verify that all earlier processes have stopped. It preserves the workspace and refuses that transition. There is no documented self-service recovery for that legacy case; keep the installation metadata and databases, and follow the [update and recovery guide](https://jobctrl.dev/user/getting-started#update-roll-back-or-remove-jobctrl). Do not delete ownership records or replace either database to bypass a refusal.

Explicit rollback restores the paired snapshot associated with the selected release. Data added after that snapshot is not carried backward. Rollback to a runtime that cannot read schema 15 remains unavailable.

## Requirements

The signed installer and Homebrew package support Apple-silicon macOS 15 or later. The app includes its own Python runtime; source development has separate toolchain requirements. Model-backed work requires a configured provider and available budget. Review generated materials and application actions before use; the browser extension does not submit applications.

**Full changelog:** [v0.4.0...v0.4.1](https://github.com/ebarti/JobCtrl/compare/v0.4.0...v0.4.1)
